sources.name: e-Cégjegyzék (Cégszolgálat ingyenes céginformáció)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Official free company-register search of the Ministry of Justice Company Information Service. HTML search, free basic company data. No public bulk API; bulk/structured data is sold via the Céginformációs Szolgálat under contract.

sources.name: OCCSZ – Cégszolgálat Online Céginformáció
sources.verdict: VERIFIED loads (title 'Cégszolgálat Online Céginformáció'). Online company-information services hub of the Company Information Service; page content is thin for non-browser clients, deeper pages likely session-driven.

sources.name: Céginformációs és az Elektronikus Cégeljárásban Közreműködő Szolgálat (Ministry of Justice)
sources.category: commercial register authority / bulk data seller
sources.verdict: NOT VERIFIED this session — fetch failed with a TLS certificate-chain error (unable to get local issuer certificate). This is the known authority page for company data services and paid bulk/group data supply; retry from a full browser.

sources.name: e-Beszámoló – electronic financial statements portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Official Ministry of Justice portal for all Hungarian company annual accounts. Free search (name / tax number / registration number), no registration required, published filings and attachments downloadable. High-value machine route to financials.

sources.name: NAV public databases (adatbázisok)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Directory of public NAV databases: VAT-registered entities, sole traders register, debt-free taxpayers, reliable/risky taxpayer lists, tax delinquents, sanction-deleted tax numbers. Online search tools; no explicit bulk download or API advertised.

sources.name: KSH – Hungarian Central Statistical Office
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session. Well-known official statistics office with open STADAT tables and business-register statistics (enterprise counts by form/sector). Download route is standard; verify exact endpoints in build.

sources.name: MNB Intézménykereső – register of supervised financial institutions
sources.category: financial regulator register (banks, investment firms, fund managers, insurers, funds)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch — homepage rendered for a non-browser client, describing simple/advanced search over MNB-licensed institutions and funds plus downloadable special datasets (cross-border provider lists etc.). Hint says detailed search is POST-driven (historically with captcha) — treat per-entity scraping as fragile; use ESMA/EBA/EIOPA EU registers as the robust machine route for HU licensees. MNB is also the MiCA authority, so crypto licensees surface here and in the ESMA MiCA register.

sources.name: MNB Aranykönyv (Golden Book – annual data of financial institutions)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session. Known MNB supervisory time-series page publishing the Aranykönyv (annual balance-sheet/P&L data per credit institution, insurer, fund manager) as Excel downloads. Verify exact URL in build.

sources.name: ESMA Registers (AIFMs, UCITS ManCos, MiFID firms, MiCA)
sources.category: EU register covering HU fund managers and investment firms
sources.verdict: VERIFIED loads (JS app shell; register list loads client-side). ESMA registers cover Hungarian AIFMs/UCITS/investment firms/MiCA licensees and expose open data endpoints — the reliable machine fallback for the captcha-prone MNB search.

sources.name: EBA credit institution register (EUCLID)
sources.category: EU register of credit institutions and payment institutions incl. HU
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session. Well-known EBA register with downloadable/API-accessible data covering Hungarian credit and payment institutions.

sources.name: EIOPA register of insurance undertakings and IORPs
sources.category: EU register of insurers and pension institutions incl. HU (LP side)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session. Known EIOPA register covering HU insurers and occupational pension institutions; access mechanics to be confirmed in build.

sources.name: Magyar Közlöny – official gazette of Hungary
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Official gazette; every issue downloadable as PDF, subject-word search with wildcards, archive to 2001 (688 pages of issues).

sources.name: Cégközlöny – company gazette
sources.verdict: EXISTS but fetch returned HTTP 403 to a non-browser client (www.e-cegkozlony.gov.hu also has a broken cert pointing at this host). This is where Hungarian liquidation/bankruptcy announcements are published — key insolvency signal source; needs a browser-grade crawler.

sources.name: Közbeszerzési Hatóság + Közbeszerzési Adatbázis (KBA)
sources.category: public procurement authority, notice database, registers of qualified/excluded bidders
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Public Procurement Authority with the KBA central notice/contract database, the Közbeszerzési Értesítő gazette, and public registers (qualified bidders, excluded bidders, contract breaches). CoRe public contract search at kereso-core.kozbeszerzes.hu for post-2018 contracts.

sources.name: EKR – electronic public procurement system
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session; known JS single-page application. Procedure-level data is easier to take from the KBA/CoRe public search than from EKR directly.

sources.name: Budapest Stock Exchange – issuer list

sources.name: BAMOSZ – Association of Hungarian Investment Fund and Asset Management Companies
sources.category: fund & asset manager association + daily fund database
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Public member list plus a daily-updated database of ALL public Hungarian investment funds, filterable by manager/category/currency, with tabular data download. Best public machine route into HU fund data.

sources.name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Hungarian Banking Association

sources.name: Magyar Lízingszövetség – Hungarian Leasing Association

sources.name: Magyar Faktoring Szövetség – Hungarian Factoring Association

sources.name: MABISZ – Association of Hungarian Insurance Companies

sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session. The EUTL is the public route to Hungarian EU ETS account holders, installations and compliance data (Hungary has no separate open national carbon-registry portal; the national administrator sits under the energy ministry).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin-to-moderate Hungary coverage: the larger HU GPs and state-linked funds (Hiventures, MFB group vehicles), some LP records for pension funds and insurers, fundraising/AUM estimates. Weak on service graph, NPL/servicers, and niche alts.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: HVCA and Invest Europe member lists/statistics, MNB licensee register (fund manager licenses), ESMA AIFM register, fund annual reports via e-beszamolo-type filings, press releases from GPs — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deal-level HU PE/VC coverage (buyouts, VC rounds, exits) with reasonable recall on announced deals; valuations mostly estimated. Little on private debt, real assets or the institutional service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Hungarian business press (Portfolio.hu, Forbes.hu, Telex/G7, VG), company-register events (Cégközlöny incorporations/changes), HVCA deal statistics, exchange disclosures (BÉT) — we can ingest each at source.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Hungarian startup/scaleup mapping is decent via CEE ecosystem reports and local partnerships; strong on founder/round taxonomy, weak on non-tech alternatives.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startup Hungary reports, HVCA/EIF program announcements, press (Forbes.hu, Portfolio), accelerator/portfolio pages (e.g. Hiventures portfolio) — all public routes we can hit directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Self-reported + press-driven HU startup coverage; patchy on rounds below Series A and on anything non-tech. Entity data often stale versus the company register.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company self-submissions and English-language press (BBJ, Daily News Hungary); the authoritative upstream (e-cégjegyzék, e-beszámoló) is public and ours to use.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The leading Hungarian company-information provider: full registry mirror, financials, litigation/insolvency flags, ownership networks, credit scores. This is the local benchmark for entity depth. Do not scrape.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bulk registry data purchased from the Céginformációs Szolgálat, Cégközlöny gazette feed, e-beszamolo financial statements, NAV public databases, court/insolvency publications — every underlying source is public or purchasable from the state directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Second major local company-data provider; similar registry-derived offering (company data, financials, monitoring, risk flags). Do not scrape.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Same state pipeline: Céginformációs Szolgálat bulk data, Cégközlöny, e-beszamolo, NAV lists.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Registry-derived firmographics, credit ratings, UBO-adjacent linkage analysis for Hungary within a global graph. Strong corporate-hierarchy data; nothing alternatives-specific.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: State registry bulk data, e-beszamolo filings, NAV databases, gazette publications.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Aggregates Hungarian macro, sector reports, company financials and local news for emerging markets; decent sector-level context, shallow on fund-level alternatives.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KSH statistics, MNB statistics/Aranykönyv, local press licensing (Portfolio, VG), registry-derived financials — the public layers (KSH, MNB, filings) are directly accessible to us.

searchedButAbsent: Process note: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task began, so discovery used the hint list + domain knowledge, verified by ~30 direct URL fetches; verdicts state per-source verification status. Searched-for but absent or unconfirmable: (1) a standalone open Hungarian insolvency register portal — insolvency/liquidation publication flows through the Cégközlöny (which 403-blocks non-browser clients) and the EU e-Justice interconnection; (2) the liquidator roll (felszámolói névjegyzék) direct URL — fni.im.gov.hu does not resolve; current home under IM/OCCSZ needs browser discovery; (3) any public bulk API for the company register — bulk data is sold under contract by the Céginformációs Szolgálat, not open; (4) open UBO data — none, consistent with EU-wide restriction; (5) RSS feeds for MNB, BÉT, MFB, ÁKK, Property Forum — none found, HTML polling required; (6) a standalone Hungarian national carbon-registry portal — the public route is the EU Transaction Log; the national ETS administrator sits under the energy ministry without an obvious open register; (7) a dedicated Hungarian NPL-servicer association — NPL/collections entities appear only via MNB licensing categories (követeléskezelő) in the Intézménykereső; (8) MNV and Hiventures and the ministry Céginformációs page all failed TLS verification from this client — real sites, retry with a browser-grade crawler; (9) Napi.hu and G7.hu no longer exist as separate outlets (301 redirects to Economx and Telex respectively).
